_about: Overnight Oct 23, Part 1: scripted mid-fight events for bosses and elites (EncounterScripts, core/dungeon/encounter_scripts.gd). Keyed like modifiers.json. Each trigger fires once: when {type: hp_below pct | turn turn | units_died count side card | foe_units_at_least count | own_units_at_most count | foe_hp_below pct}; effects in order (rule, remove_rule, summon, card, heal, shield, damage, resources, buff, debuff_foes, exhaust_foes, draw, foe_heal, exhaust_own). text = what can happen (shown with the rule icons from the start), line = the foe's line when it fires, banner = what just happened, warn = the one-line warning the turn before a timed event. Generated from _logs/make_scripts.js; edit either.

Hollow Warden.name: The Warden Stirs
Hollow Warden.text: At half health the Warden wakes a little more: a Cave Echo rises beside it.
Hollow Warden.line: ...That light in your hands. I have seen that light before. No... no, you cannot be him. He is gone. He has been gone so long.
Hollow Warden.banner: A Cave Echo rises beside the Warden.

town:npc:beefcake.name: HYDRATION BREAK
town:npc:beefcake.text: At half health Brick stops to drink: he heals 3, and his units stand down through his next turn.
town:npc:beefcake.line: HYDRATION BREAK! NOBODY LIFTS DURING HYDRATION, AND THAT IS THE LAW! ...It is a good law.
town:npc:beefcake.banner: Brick heals 3. His units are exhausted and miss his next turn.

town:npc:gourmand.name: TASTE IT!
town:npc:gourmand.text: At half health Fennel force-feeds you a biscuit (you heal 2) and a 1/1 Snack joins his side.
town:npc:gourmand.line: TASTE IT! Even the BISCUIT is for the war effort!
town:npc:gourmand.banner: You heal 2. A 1/1 Snack joins Fennel.

town:npc:refusemancer.name: Did I Thorn at You?
town:npc:refusemancer.text: At half health the real Moss breaks through for a moment: the thorns loosen and you heal 3.
town:npc:refusemancer.line: ...grow... GROW... (small) Did I thorn at you? I'm sorry, I can't make it stop...

town:npc:necrocrat.name: Stamped APPROVED
town:npc:necrocrat.text: At half health Prudence grabs the wrong stamp: APPROVED. You heal 3.
town:npc:necrocrat.line: APPROVED. ...Oh. That was the wrong stamp, and I am afraid it felt rather nice. Please disregard that.
town:npc:necrocrat.banner: Prudence stamps APPROVED by mistake: you heal 3.

town:graveyard.name: The Count Pauses
town:graveyard.text: At half health the dead lose count: their units stand still through their next turn.
town:graveyard.line: The counting stops. Somewhere under the stones, someone has lost their place.
town:graveyard.banner: The dead stand still: their units miss their next turn.

town:graveyard.name: The Cairn Remembers
town:graveyard.text: Near the end the dead hesitate: their units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
town:graveyard.line: The dead stop. They look at your hands as if they have seen them before.

rule.name: The Cairn Remembers
rule.text: The dead hesitate: their units get -1/-0.

town:graveyard.banner: The dead hesitate: their units get -1/-0.

town:ninja.name: SMOKE BOMB!!!
town:ninja.text: At half health Shiro throws a smoke bomb: your strongest ready unit is exhausted and misses your next turn.
town:ninja.line: SMOKE BOMB!!! It's the oldest trick in the book, right there on page one, and I should know, because I wrote page one.
town:ninja.banner: Your strongest ready unit is lost in the smoke until after your next turn.

town:ninja.name: Body Double
town:ninja.text: Near the end Shiro swaps places with a log: the next 4 damage to him is absorbed.
town:ninja.line: You hit a log! A very convincing log, I grant you, because I gave it my eyebrows, and I shall be wanting those back.
town:ninja.banner: Shiro's log absorbs the next 4 damage.

town:vault.name: The Seal of Iron Breaks
town:vault.text: At half health the first seal breaks and the Warden gathers the pieces: the next 3 damage to it is absorbed.
town:vault.line: One seal for one Path, and the hand is real. Show me the rest of it.
town:vault.banner: The Warden gathers the broken seal: the next 3 damage is absorbed.

town:vault.name: The Last Seal
town:vault.text: Near the end the last seal opens: the Warden's units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
town:vault.line: The last seal opens. The four Paths agreed to bury this, and they agreed that one day you might come for it.

rule.name: Seals Spent
rule.text: The seals are spent: the Warden's units get -1/-0.

town:old_well.name: Ripples
town:old_well.text: At half health the water answers: two 1/1 Ripples rise on the Echo's side.
town:old_well.line: ...you were here... you were small... the water remembers the shape of you...
town:old_well.banner: Two 1/1 Ripples rise from the well.

town:old_well.name: Still Water
town:old_well.text: Near the end the spring gathers itself: the Echo heals 3.
town:old_well.line: ...not yet... the spring runs once more...

zone:gourmand:casserole.name: Honour Duel
zone:gourmand:casserole.text: At half health Colonel Casserole demands a proper duel: his units get +1/+1 for the rest of the fight.
zone:gourmand:casserole.line: En garde! In thirty years of service I have never once boiled over, and I had hoped to retire with that record intact, but you do press a casserole hard. Yes, Chef.

rule.name: Honour Duel
rule.text: Casserole fights with honour: his units get +1/+1.

zone:final:spotless.name: HALT
zone:final:spotless.text: At half health Spotless barks an order: your strongest ready unit stands to attention (exhausted).
zone:final:spotless.line: HALT! Stand at attention. No, not at your own attention: at THAT attention!
zone:final:spotless.banner: Your strongest ready unit is exhausted.

Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency.name: Efficiency Review
Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency.text: At half health Quota reviews her numbers: she draws a card.
Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency.line: Your performance stands at forty-one percent of acceptable. Mine is about to improve.

capital:quota.name: Mandatory Break
capital:quota.text: At half health Quota's own break schedule kicks in: she draws a card, and her units take a two-minute break (exhausted through her next turn).
capital:quota.line: A two-minute break is now mandatory. I wrote that schedule myself, and I resent it.
capital:quota.banner: Quota draws a card; her units take a break through her next turn.

Trophy Hall Honor Guard.name: Empty Trophy
Trophy Hall Honor Guard.text: At half health a reserve guard steps off a pedestal: a 1/1 Reserve Guard joins.
Trophy Hall Honor Guard.line: Reserves, off your pedestal! This trophy belongs to the Chancellor, not to some stranger off the wheels!
Trophy Hall Honor Guard.banner: A 1/1 Reserve Guard steps off a pedestal.

Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.name: Brownout
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.text: On his 5th turn Clench cuts the wheel power: your two strongest ready units are exhausted and cannot block that turn.
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.line: CUT THE POWER and get everyone off the wheels! Nobody in this house moves a muscle until I say REP!
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.warn: Next turn: Clench cuts the power (your two strongest units cannot block).
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.banner: The lights go out: your two strongest ready units are exhausted.

Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.name: DROP AND GIVE ME FORMS
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.text: At half health Clench pulls the emergency reserve: he gains 2 Iron.
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.line: Control is strength, paperwork is control, and do you know how HEAVY paperwork gets? Two more plates!

Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.name: Master...?
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.text: Near the end Clench falters: his units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent.line: You told me I would go further than you ever did. Well, look how far I went. Tell me it was far enough. ...Master?

Baron Quadzilla.name: Final Set
Baron Quadzilla.text: At half health the Baron starts his final set: his units get +1/+0 for the rest of the fight.
Baron Quadzilla.line: Nobody. Skips. Leg day. (rep) Final set. (rep) In my cave.

rule.name: Final Set
rule.text: The Baron's final set: his units get +1/+0.

Baron Quadzilla.name: He Stands Up
Baron Quadzilla.text: Near the end the Baron stands for the first time in years: he heals 2, and wobbles (his units get -1/-0).
Baron Quadzilla.line: Standing. Huh. Wobbly. Like a first rep.

rule.name: Wobbly
rule.text: Standing up is hard: his units get -1/-0.

Baron Quadzilla.banner: The Baron heals 2, but his units get -1/-0.

The Ancient Spotter.name: One More Rep
The Ancient Spotter.text: At half health the Spotter catches the weight: it heals 4.
The Ancient Spotter.line: Lift. I will catch it. I have always caught it.

The Ancient Spotter.name: Young Spotters
The Ancient Spotter.text: On its 6th turn two 1/1 Young Spotters climb up to help it.
The Ancient Spotter.line: Never lift alone. Not even me.
The Ancient Spotter.warn: Next turn: two Young Spotters climb up the mountain.

Unfinished War Machine.name: Self-Repair
Unfinished War Machine.text: When three of its units have been scrapped, the machine patches itself: it heals 2.

Cannon-Blender Gunner.name: Full Blend
Cannon-Blender Gunner.text: On its 4th turn the cannon-blender fires a full load: you take 2 damage.
Cannon-Blender Gunner.line: Load the smoothie, set it to puree, and FIRE!
Cannon-Blender Gunner.warn: Next turn: the cannon-blender fires a full load (2 damage).

The Doppelganger.name: The Mask Slips
The Doppelganger.text: At half health the disguise slips: Plated Just So ends (its units lose +1/+1), and two 1/1 Sashimi Weenies are rushed out.
The Doppelganger.line: Delicious... delicious. I was told that is the word. ...Why will this face not stay on?
The Doppelganger.banner: Plated Just So ends. Two 1/1 Sashimi Weenies are rushed out.

The Doppelganger.name: No Face of Its Own
The Doppelganger.text: Near the end the face it wore is gone: its units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
The Doppelganger.line: They were always asking whether I had tasted the soup. ...I never did, and I do not think that I ever could.

rule.name: Faceless
rule.text: No face of its own: its units get -1/-0.

The Doppelganger.banner: The Doppelganger falters: its units get -1/-0.

The Itamae Supreme.name: Omakase
The Itamae Supreme.text: On his 4th turn the Itamae serves you a course, as the custom is: you heal 2.
The Itamae Supreme.warn: Next turn: the Itamae serves the next course.
The Itamae Supreme.banner: The Itamae serves you: you heal 2.

The Itamae Supreme.name: ...Enough.
The Itamae Supreme.text: Near the end the Itamae sets down his knife: his units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.

rule.name: The Last Course
rule.text: The knife is down: his units get -1/-0.

Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.name: Battle Rations
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.text: At half health Crumb issues paste: he gains 2 Ingredients.
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.line: Battle rations, issue! Taste is a weakness, and paste is a strategy!

Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.name: Paste Barrage
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.text: On his 6th turn the vats open fire: you take 2 damage.
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.line: Battle stations! This is not a drill, soldier, it is a souffle! Vats, FIRE!
Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Cul.warn: Next turn: Crumb orders a paste barrage (2 damage).

Notary Wraith.name: In Triplicate
Notary Wraith.text: At half health the Wraith notarizes a Red Tape for itself.
Notary Wraith.line: Signed, witnessed and notarized in triplicate. One copy is for you, but you may not keep it.
Notary Wraith.banner: The Notary Wraith gains a Red Tape.

Undersecretary Vellum.name: Noted.
Undersecretary Vellum.text: At half health Vellum files an objection: he gains a Contract.

Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.name: Mortimer Files a Form
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.text: On his 4th turn Mortimer files Form 27-B: a 1/1 Filing Clerk is hired to process it.
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.line: Your appeal has been received, reviewed and denied. For the record, it was a very good appeal.
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.warn: Next turn: Mortimer files Form 27-B (a clerk is hired).

Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.name: Filed on a Tuesday
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.text: Late in the fight Mortimer finds a note under his own form: FILED ON A TUESDAY. His units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.line: The authorization is valid. It was filed on a Tuesday. ...We do not file on Tuesdays.

rule.name: Filed on a Tuesday
rule.text: An irregular filing: his units get -1/-0.

Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No.banner: Mortimer hesitates over the form: his units get -1/-0.

Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.name: Forms A through F
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.text: At half health Betty hands over forms A through F: she gains 2 Contracts and a 1/1 Zombie Temp files in.
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.line: Forms A through F, all six, in black ink. Then we'll talk. We won't, but still.
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.banner: Betty gains 2 Contracts; a 1/1 Zombie Temp files in.

Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.name: Out to Lunch
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.text: On her 5th turn Betty takes her lunch break: her units stand down (exhausted) for that turn, because nothing gets done on lunch.
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.line: I'm on lunch, and nothing happens on lunch. That includes me, and it certainly includes you.
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.warn: Next turn: Betty goes on lunch (her units stand down for a turn).
Betty Bones, Surly Secretary.banner: Betty is on lunch: her units are exhausted this turn.

Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper.name: Regulation Topiary
Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper.text: At half health Clipwell trims two topiaries into guards: two 1/2 Topiaries join her.
Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper.line: Gentlemen, if you would? He's grown well over regulation height.

Hive of Mutant Bees.name: The Hive Swarms
Hive of Mutant Bees.text: When two of its units have died, the hive swarms: two 1/1 Mutant Bees with Flying buzz in.
Hive of Mutant Bees.banner: Two 1/1 flying Mutant Bees buzz in.

Compostella, the Rotheart.name: The Roots Spread
Compostella, the Rotheart.text: At half health the roots spread: two 1/1 Sporelings sprout and her units get +0/+1.
Compostella, the Rotheart.line: ...I am the bin you never empty... nothing leaves... I am HUNGRY...
Compostella, the Rotheart.banner: Two Sporelings sprout; her units get +0/+1.

Compostella, the Rotheart.name: Please. The Tree.
Compostella, the Rotheart.text: Near the end a small voice breaks through: her units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
Compostella, the Rotheart.line: (small) Please. The tree. I could not let her go.

rule.name: Letting Go
rule.text: The small voice: her units get -1/-0.

Compostella, the Rotheart.banner: The hungry green falters: her units get -1/-0.

His Majesty the Raccoon.name: The Royal Bins
His Majesty the Raccoon.text: At half health the royal guard of bins rallies: a 1/1 Rat joins and he gains a Garbage.
His Majesty the Raccoon.line: WE DID NOT EAT THE COMPOST. We... audited it. Orally. And we shall hear no more about it from you. GUARDS!
His Majesty the Raccoon.banner: A 1/1 Rat joins; His Majesty gains a Garbage.

His Majesty the Raccoon.name: Sweating Profusely
His Majesty the Raccoon.text: Near the end His Majesty starts to sweat: his units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
His Majesty the Raccoon.line: We were only testing the compost on the realm's behalf, and we were very thorough about it. ...Is it warm in here? We find that it is very warm in here.

rule.name: Sweating
rule.text: His Majesty is sweating: his units get -1/-0.

Enforcer Sergeant Scuff.name: Inspection
Enforcer Sergeant Scuff.text: On his 5th turn Scuff holds an inspection, just as the Captain taught him: your strongest ready unit stands to attention (exhausted) and cannot block.
Enforcer Sergeant Scuff.line: INSPECTION! The Captain wants heights, he wants smudges, and he wants every smile at the regulation angle!
Enforcer Sergeant Scuff.warn: Next turn: Scuff holds an inspection (your strongest unit cannot block).
Enforcer Sergeant Scuff.banner: Your strongest ready unit stands to attention.

Enforcer Sergeant Scuff.name: A SMUDGE
Enforcer Sergeant Scuff.text: Near the end Scuff notices the mud on his own boots: his units get -1/-0 while he scrubs.
Enforcer Sergeant Scuff.line: Mud. On the boots. The Captain will see it from all the way up there, I know he will.

rule.name: Scrubbing
rule.text: Scuff is scrubbing his boots: his units get -1/-0.

Enforcer Sergeant Scuff.banner: Scuff scrubs his boots: his units get -1/-0.

Mirror Knight.name: Reflection
Mirror Knight.text: At half health a reflection steps out of the glass: a 1/1 Reflection joins (Polished makes it 4/2).
Mirror Knight.line: Every mirror in this hall agrees with His Perfection. So does this one.
Mirror Knight.banner: A Reflection steps out of the glass.

Royal Staircase Guard.name: Hold the Stair
Royal Staircase Guard.text: At half health the guard plants his feet: the next 3 damage to him is absorbed.
Royal Staircase Guard.line: No one climbs this stair. It has been polished by seventeen people, and I will not have it scuffed.
Royal Staircase Guard.banner: The guard absorbs the next 3 damage.

Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.name: Positive Spin
Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.text: At half health Plume announces that he is fine: he heals 2.
Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.line: Great news, citizens! I have been approved to feel fine!

Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.name: Filing Deadline
Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.text: When Plume's 12th turn begins the office closes and you lose the duel. Win before then.
Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.line: And that is the end of the filing day! Do come back tomorrow. There is always a tomorrow, we have a great many in stock.
Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.warn: Next turn: the filing deadline. Win now, or the office closes and the duel is lost.
Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good.banner: The filing day is over. The office is closed.

Clocktower Sentinel.name: The Hour Strikes
Clocktower Sentinel.text: On its 4th turn the clock strikes: your two strongest ready units are exhausted and cannot block that turn.
Clocktower Sentinel.line: BONG. The hour has been standardized. All movement will now cease.
Clocktower Sentinel.warn: Next turn: the hour strikes (your two strongest units cannot block).
Clocktower Sentinel.banner: The hour strikes: your two strongest ready units are exhausted.

Primm (standardization).name: Out of Alignment
Primm (standardization).text: At half health Primm corrects the room: the next 2 damage to him is absorbed.
Primm (standardization).line: Do hold still. You are a fraction of a degree out of alignment, and I find I cannot leave it. There, that is better.

Primm (reflection).name: Every Mirror Agrees
Primm (reflection).text: On his 5th turn a polished reflection steps out to stand with him: a 2/2 Reflection.
Primm (reflection).line: Every mirror in this castle agrees with me. I find that very restful.
Primm (reflection).warn: Next turn: a reflection steps out of the mirrors.

Primm (unraveling).name: I Only Wanted It to Be Nice
Primm (unraveling).text: Near the end Primm comes apart: his units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
Primm (unraveling).line: I only wanted it to be nice, for everyone. It was for their own good. Why won't anyone let it be for their own good?

rule.name: Unraveling
rule.text: Primm is coming apart: his units get -1/-0.

The Failed Experiment.name: Mutation
The Failed Experiment.text: At half health the experiment sheds a piece of itself: a 1/1 Discarded Sample crawls out.
The Failed Experiment.line: GRRRK. (The tag on its wrist reads: BATCH 12. DISCONTINUED.)

The Failed Experiment.name: Growth Spurt
The Failed Experiment.text: On its 4th turn the Experiment has a growth spurt: a 2/2 Patchwork Body splits off it.
The Failed Experiment.warn: Next turn: a growth spurt (a 2/2 unit splits off).
The Failed Experiment.banner: A 2/2 Patchwork Body splits off the Experiment.

The Drain Warden.name: Drain Cycle
The Drain Warden.text: On its 4th turn the drain cycle runs: you take 2 damage and the Warden heals 2.
The Drain Warden.line: Cycle four. Subject output nominal. Begin extraction.
The Drain Warden.warn: Next turn: the drain cycle runs (you lose 2, it heals 2).
The Drain Warden.banner: You take 2 damage; the Drain Warden heals 2.

The Drain Warden.name: Overdrain
The Drain Warden.text: Low on power the Warden overdrains: you take 2 damage and it heals 2.
The Drain Warden.banner: Overdrain: you take 2 damage; the Warden heals 2.

Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.name: This Will Only Drain a Little
Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.text: At half health Siphon opens a valve: you take 2 damage and he heals 2.
Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.line: This will only drain a little. You really have grown, Subject 1, and I find it quite remarkable.

Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.name: Fascinating Data
Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.text: Near the end Siphon takes notes: he draws 2 cards.
Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist.line: Fascinating! My finest work is fighting back, and with such spirit. Do carry on; I must write this down.

The Old Kingdom Automaton.name: Recalibrate
The Old Kingdom Automaton.text: At half health the Automaton recalibrates: the next 3 damage to it is absorbed.
The Old Kingdom Automaton.banner: The Automaton absorbs the next 3 damage.

The Old Kingdom Automaton.name: Recognised
The Old Kingdom Automaton.text: Near the end the Automaton hesitates: its units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.

rule.name: Recognised
rule.text: The Automaton hesitates: its units get -1/-0.

The Old Kingdom Automaton.banner: The Automaton hesitates: its units get -1/-0.

arena:arena_spells_only.name: Getting Soggy
arena:arena_spells_only.text: At half health the Colossus gets soggy: its units get -1/-0 for the rest of the fight.
arena:arena_spells_only.line: THE COLOSSUS IS... DAMP! (normal voice) I'm so sorry, someone has left the mop bucket out again, and I rather think it was me.
arena:arena_spells_only.banner: The Colossus is soggy: its units get -1/-0.

arena:arena_four_fists.name: The Fourth Fist
arena:arena_four_fists.text: At half health the Champion uses its fourth fist: its units get +1/+0 for the rest of the fight.
arena:arena_four_fists.line: THE CHAMPION RAISES ITS FOURTH FIST! (normal voice) I've announced that for years, and I still couldn't tell you where it keeps it.

rule.name: Fourth Fist
rule.text: All four fists: its units get +1/+0.

arena:arena_marshal.name: THE CROWD GOES WILD
arena:arena_marshal.text: On his 3rd turn the crowd joins in: a 1/1 Rowdy Fan climbs into the ring.
arena:arena_marshal.line: THE CROWD! GOES! WILD! (normal voice) Could the crowd please stay behind the rope, though? I did put up a rope, and it took me most of the morning.
arena:arena_marshal.warn: Next turn: a fan climbs into the ring.
arena:arena_marshal.banner: A 1/1 Rowdy Fan climbs into the ring.

arena:arena_marshal.name: INTERMISSION
arena:arena_marshal.text: At half health Bellows calls an intermission: he heals 2, and his units sit down through his next turn.
arena:arena_marshal.line: INTERMISSION! (normal voice) I'll be having my soup, if nobody minds, and I'm sorry to report that so far THE SOUP IS WINNING.
arena:arena_marshal.banner: Bellows heals 2; his units sit out his next turn.

Coup Barracks Sergeant.name: Hold the Line
Coup Barracks Sergeant.text: When the Sergeant's 6th turn begins, if a Captured Trainee is still alive, the barracks gives up and you win.
Coup Barracks Sergeant.line: They're still standing? Nobody told me they would still be standing.
Coup Barracks Sergeant.warn: Next turn: if a Captured Trainee still stands, the barracks gives up.
Coup Barracks Sergeant.banner: The line held. The barracks gives up.

Seed Vault Gardener.name: Clean Out the Polish
Seed Vault Gardener.text: When all three Spotless Statues are destroyed, the Gardener has nothing left to guard: you win.
Seed Vault Gardener.line: You've let the damp in. Do you know how long it takes to wax a seed?
Seed Vault Gardener.banner: The last statue falls. The vault is yours.

Maurice, Head of Security.name: Calling for Backup
Maurice, Head of Security.text: When three of his units have died, Maurice whistles: two 2/2 House Security step out from behind the curtain.
Maurice, Head of Security.line: Right. That's it. LADS! We have got a situation at the rope.

Tilda Tinsel, Confetti Cannoneer.name: The Grand Finale
Tilda Tinsel, Confetti Cannoneer.text: At half health Tilda fires everything she has left: her units get +1/+0 for good.
Tilda Tinsel, Confetti Cannoneer.line: You want a finale? I'll GIVE you a finale! Cover your ears, sweetie!

Madame Darjeeling.name: A Cup for the Guest
Madame Darjeeling.text: On her turn 4 she pours you a cup: you gain 3 HP, and she draws a card. Manners cost nothing.
Madame Darjeeling.line: One lump or two, dear? I do so hate to thrash a guest on an empty stomach.
Madame Darjeeling.banner: You gain 3 HP. Madame Darjeeling draws a card.
Madame Darjeeling.warn: Next turn: Madame Darjeeling pours you a cup (you gain 3 HP).

Madame Darjeeling.name: The Second Pot
Madame Darjeeling.text: At 40% health she rings for the second pot: she gains 4 HP and a 4/4 Cake Golem rolls in on the trolley.
Madame Darjeeling.line: Oh, we are not nearly finished. Albert! The SECOND pot. And the good cake.
Madame Darjeeling.banner: She gains 4 HP. A 4/4 Cake Golem arrives.

\"Honest\" Hal Lowball.name: Hal Folds
\"Honest\" Hal Lowball.text: At 30% health, if you control three or more units, Hal reads the table and folds: you win the fight on the spot.
\"Honest\" Hal Lowball.line: I know when I'm beat. I don't know it often, mind. Take the pot, take the pot.
\"Honest\" Hal Lowball.banner: Hal folds. The pot is yours.

\"Honest\" Hal Lowball.name: A Marked Deck
\"Honest\" Hal Lowball.text: On his turn 5 Hal deals himself two off the bottom: he draws two cards.
\"Honest\" Hal Lowball.line: Would you look at that. Two aces. In this light they could be anything, really.
\"Honest\" Hal Lowball.warn: Next turn: Hal deals himself two off the bottom (he draws two cards).

Trey Pickett.name: Going Once...
Trey Pickett.text: On his turn 3: going once. Your strongest ready unit is sold out from under you (it is exhausted).
Trey Pickett.line: Going ONCE! (ding!) Do I hear a higher bid? I do not! The big fella sits this one out!
Trey Pickett.banner: Your strongest ready unit is exhausted.
Trey Pickett.warn: Next turn: going once (your strongest ready unit is exhausted).

Trey Pickett.name: Going Twice...
Trey Pickett.text: On his turn 5: going twice. Your two strongest ready units are exhausted.
Trey Pickett.line: Going TWICE! (ding ding!) Two lots, one price, no refunds, pick it, pick it, PICK IT!
Trey Pickett.banner: Your two strongest ready units are exhausted.
Trey Pickett.warn: Next turn: going twice (your two strongest ready units are exhausted).

Trey Pickett.name: SOLD!
Trey Pickett.text: On his turn 7: SOLD! The gavel comes down, and Trey's units get +2/+0 for good. Beat him before the hammer falls.
Trey Pickett.line: SOLD! (DING DING DING!) To the handsome shark in the stripes! That's me! I bought everything!
Trey Pickett.warn: Next turn: SOLD! Trey's units get +2/+0 for good.

Dizzy Lizzie, Carousel Queen.name: The Music Stops
Dizzy Lizzie, Carousel Queen.text: On her turn 4 the music stops and everybody has to get off: her units are exhausted and miss her next turn. That is your opening.
Dizzy Lizzie, Carousel Queen.line: Oh, bother. That's the end of the tune. Everybody OFF! Mind the step! ...Why are you smiling like that?
Dizzy Lizzie, Carousel Queen.banner: The carousel stops: Lizzie's units are exhausted and miss her next turn.
Dizzy Lizzie, Carousel Queen.warn: Next turn: the music stops (her units stand down for a turn).

Dizzy Lizzie, Carousel Queen.name: Faster! FASTER!
Dizzy Lizzie, Carousel Queen.text: At 35% health Lizzie throws the lever all the way over: her units get +1/+0 for good.
Dizzy Lizzie, Carousel Queen.line: FASTER! I said FASTER! Hold on to your hats, your teeth and each other!

Professor Fineprint.name: An Amendment
Professor Fineprint.text: On his turn 4 he amends the house rules: "No Running" is struck out, and Rule 2 comes in for both sides: each player draws an extra card each turn.
Professor Fineprint.line: Point of order! I move to strike Rule 1 and adopt Rule 2. All in favour? I am. Carried. Do keep up.

rule.name: Rule 2: Open Book
rule.text: House rule, both sides: draw an extra card each turn. (His side.)

rule.name: Rule 2: Open Book
rule.text: House rule, both sides: draw an extra card each turn. (Your side.)

Professor Fineprint.banner: Rule 1 is struck out. Rule 2: each player draws an extra card each turn.
Professor Fineprint.warn: Next turn: an amendment (Rule 1 goes; both players draw an extra card each turn).

Dex Shufflewick.name: The Wheel: Red
Dex Shufflewick.text: On his turn 3 the wheel lands on red: both players pay the table. You lose 2 HP, and Dex's units are exhausted for the spin.
Dex Shufflewick.line: Red! Everybody pays the table on red. Yes, me too, I stand very still for it. House rules.
Dex Shufflewick.banner: Red: you lose 2 HP, and Dex's units are exhausted.

Dex Shufflewick.name: The Wheel: Black
Dex Shufflewick.text: On his turn 5 the wheel lands on black: Dex's units get +1/+1 for good.
Dex Shufflewick.line: Black! Lovely colour. Slimming. And what do you know, it's the one I had my chips on.

Dex Shufflewick.name: The Wheel: Double Zero
Dex Shufflewick.text: On his turn 7 the wheel lands on the double zero, and the house wins: Dex gains 4 HP and draws two cards.
Dex Shufflewick.line: Double zero. Oh dear. Oh dear, oh dear. That one's just... mine. All of it. Sorry! Not sorry!
Dex Shufflewick.banner: Double zero: Dex gains 4 HP and draws two cards.
Dex Shufflewick.warn: Next turn: the wheel spins (double zero).

Penny Sleeves.name: You Break It, You Bought It
Penny Sleeves.text: When three of her units have died, Penny rings it all up: you lose 3 HP.
Penny Sleeves.line: That is THREE. Three! Do you know what those were worth sealed? I am ringing it up. All of it.
Penny Sleeves.banner: Penny rings it up: you lose 3 HP.

Penny Sleeves.name: Clearance Sale
Penny Sleeves.text: At 40% health everything must go: Penny draws two cards and makes two Iron.
Penny Sleeves.line: Fine. FINE. Clearance sale! Everything must go! Mostly at you!
Penny Sleeves.banner: Penny draws two cards and gets two Iron.

Octavia Eightfold.name: The Big Wheel: Iron
Octavia Eightfold.text: At 75% health the Big Wheel spins and lands on Iron: Octavia's units get +1/+0 for good.
Octavia Eightfold.line: Spin it, darlings! ...IRON! Oh, I do love it when the wheel has opinions. Chins up, my lovelies, and HIT them.
Octavia Eightfold.banner: The wheel lands on Iron: her units get +1/+0.

Octavia Eightfold.name: The Big Wheel: The Kitchen
Octavia Eightfold.text: At half health the wheel lands on the Kitchen: Octavia gains 3 HP and a 4/4 Cake Golem rolls out from the wings.
Octavia Eightfold.line: And again! ...The KITCHEN! Somebody wheel in the cake. No, the BIG cake. The one with the fists.
Octavia Eightfold.banner: The wheel lands on the Kitchen: she gains 3 HP, and a 4/4 Cake Golem arrives.

Octavia Eightfold.name: The Big Wheel: Red Tape
Octavia Eightfold.text: At 25% health the wheel lands on Red Tape: your two strongest ready units are tied up (exhausted), and Octavia draws two cards.
Octavia Eightfold.line: One more spin for the road! ...RED TAPE. Oh, how dreary. For YOU, darling. Do hold still, there are forms.
Octavia Eightfold.banner: The wheel lands on Red Tape: your two strongest ready units are exhausted, and she draws two.

Echo of Vivienne Quota.name: Efficiency Review
Echo of Vivienne Quota.text: At half health Quota's Echo reviews her numbers: she draws a card.

Echo of Chancellor Clench.name: Brownout
Echo of Chancellor Clench.text: On his 5th turn Clench's Echo cuts the wheel power: your two strongest ready units are exhausted and cannot block that turn.
Echo of Chancellor Clench.warn: Next turn: Clench's Echo cuts the power (your two strongest units cannot block).
Echo of Chancellor Clench.banner: The lights go out: your two strongest ready units are exhausted.

Echo of Chancellor Clench.name: DROP AND GIVE ME FORMS
Echo of Chancellor Clench.text: At half health Clench's Echo pulls the emergency reserve: he gains 2 Iron.

Echo of Percival Plume.name: Positive Spin
Echo of Percival Plume.text: At half health Plume's Echo announces that he is fine: he heals 2.

Echo of Percival Plume.name: Filing Deadline
Echo of Percival Plume.text: When the Echo's 12th turn begins the office in the glass closes and you lose the duel. Win before then.
Echo of Percival Plume.warn: Next turn: the filing deadline in the glass. Win now, or the duel is lost.
Echo of Percival Plume.banner: The filing day is over. The office is closed.

Echo of Mortimer Grimsby.name: Mortimer Files a Form
Echo of Mortimer Grimsby.text: On his 4th turn Mortimer's Echo files Form 27-B: a 1/1 Filing Clerk is hired to process it.
Echo of Mortimer Grimsby.warn: Next turn: Mortimer's Echo files Form 27-B (a clerk is hired).

Echo of the Doppelganger.name: The Mask Slips
Echo of the Doppelganger.text: At half health the Echo's mask slips, and nothing changes underneath: two 1/1 Sashimi Weenies are rushed out.
Echo of the Doppelganger.banner: Two 1/1 Sashimi Weenies are rushed out.

Echo of Hortensia Clipwell.name: Regulation Topiary
Echo of Hortensia Clipwell.text: At half health Clipwell's Echo trims two topiaries into guards: two 1/2 Topiaries join her.

Echo of the Rotheart.name: The Roots Spread
Echo of the Rotheart.text: At half health the roots spread: two 1/1 Sporelings sprout and the Echo's units get +0/+1.
Echo of the Rotheart.banner: Two Sporelings sprout; the Echo's units get +0/+1.

Intake Orderly.name: Sedation Round
Intake Orderly.text: On its 3rd turn the Orderly does the sedation round: your two strongest ready units are exhausted and cannot block that turn.
Intake Orderly.warn: Next turn: the sedation round (your two strongest units cannot block).
Intake Orderly.banner: Sedation round: your two strongest ready units are exhausted.

Escaped Specimen.name: Shed Skin
Escaped Specimen.text: At half health the Specimen sheds its skin: it heals 3.

Hybrid Specimen.name: Splice
Hybrid Specimen.text: On its 5th turn the Hybrid splices in a Toro Toro (4/6, Bulldoze, Swat), straight onto the field.
Hybrid Specimen.warn: Next turn: the Hybrid splices in a Toro Toro (4/6).
Hybrid Specimen.banner: A Toro Toro is spliced in.

Siphon's Research Assistant.name: Lab Samples
Siphon's Research Assistant.text: On its 3rd turn the Assistant opens the sample fridge: two 1/1 Sashimi Weenies join it.
Siphon's Research Assistant.warn: Next turn: the sample fridge opens (two 1/1 units).
Siphon's Research Assistant.banner: Two 1/1 Sashimi Weenies join the Assistant.

Siphon's Research Assistant.name: The Big Project

Siphon's Research Assistant.warn: Next turn: the big project wakes up (a 7/7 Landfill Leviathan).
Siphon's Research Assistant.banner: The big project wakes up: a 7/7 Landfill Leviathan.

Antechamber Sentry.name: Lockdown
Antechamber Sentry.text: At half health the antechamber goes into lockdown: the Sentry's units get +2/+0 for the rest of the fight.

Rival Lifter at Base Camp.name: Second Set
Rival Lifter at Base Camp.text: At half health the Rival goes for a second set: it heals 4.

Squat Rack Sentinel.name: Rack Pull
Squat Rack Sentinel.text: On its 4th turn the Sentinel drops the bar: your strongest ready unit is exhausted and cannot block that turn.

Squat Rack Sentinel.banner: Your strongest ready unit is pinned under the bar.
